violations.reason: The existing reservation 4FDFNE was DTW to MSP (step 7). The agent then called update_reservation_flights with flight HAT035, whose route is DTW to PHX (steps 2 and 14), and the updated reservation contains that DTW to PHX flight (step 15). This changes the destination from MSP to PHX, which the policy prohibits for flight modifications.
